decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several speakers ranging from budget-friendly portables to high-end home units. The Bose SoundLink Color II (prod_bluetooth_speakers_137) stood out for its balance of brand reputation, high rating of 4.6, and massive volume of positive feedback from over 60,000 users. While the EWA A106 was tempting for its value, I preferred the audio fidelity and water-resistance features of the Bose for more versatile use. The Harman Kardon Onyx was a contender for its sound quality, but its weight made it less portable than the SoundLink. I excluded cases and novelty items that appeared to prioritize form over audio performance.
